chapter.heading: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
chapter.v:
O God,
thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

To see
thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

Because thy
lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

Thus will
I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

My soul
shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

When I
remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

Because thou
hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

My soul
followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

But those
that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

They shall
fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

But the
king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
